comparison.objective: Remove a retained 5378 terminal vs insert a ferruled wire into a selected push-in terminal block entry.
comparison.physical_skill: Blade-under-locking-tab insertion, wire deflection, and coupled withdrawal vs precise ferrule alignment, straight insertion, and spring-clamp engagement.
comparison.success_condition: Selected terminal exits without damage or neighboring release vs ferrule reaches home in the correct entry and survives a 50 N pull test.
comparison.reason: They concern electrical terminals but test opposite operations and different retention mechanisms; common alignment and axial motion are insufficient for overlap.
